text:
alex_marketing: Hey runtime team — for the Wed webinar demo we need a small bench sweep to validate the launch claims. Can you run a mini-pack with:
- sample payloads (QA + live-like)
- coldstart and long-context tails (~1k+ tokens)
- quantized variants (q4m + q4f)
Wanted: p50/p95/p99 latency, token/sec throughput, warmup profile (first 10/100 requests), and per-route cost estimates. Attach raw traces and a brief README on methodology.

Example payload (curl):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","input":"Summarize: <long sample>"}'
```

alex_marketing: Priority is demo-readiness for the keynote: small cohort (20 seeds) + a randomized tail sample. Need artifacts and a short summary by Tue EOD. @toni_engineer can we get this? :pray:

toni_engineer: Yep we can run a focused sweep. Quick qs: which quant config do you want as the canonical claim (q4m/q4f) and do you want embedding+rerank traces included?

alex_marketing: Canonical claim = q4m. q4f only if the variance is <10% on p95. Include embedding rerank traces (we demo similarity search).

sam_runtime: I'll queue runs on the staging dedicated pool tomorrow AM. We'll include KV-cache warmup, a coldstart-only pass, and a mixed stream pass. benchbot will post run IDs & artifact locations.

benchbot: run_27134 started on staging-dedicated-3 (params: seeds=20, contexts=[128,1024,10000], quant=[q4m,q4f], passes=[coldstart,warmup,mixed]). ETA ~2h.

maya: Also need per-route failure/error rates and 5 example "bad" outputs for quick QA to surface quality regressions. Can you attach a mini-eval harness (automated prompts + pass/fail) with each run?

toni_engineer: Yep. We'll produce: sample_outputs.jsonl (seed,model,quant,raw_out), latency_summary.csv, and eval_report.md with the tiny harness and pass criteria.

liam_product: Heads-up: content wants a 1-line latency stat for the press kit. If p95 > 300ms on demo config we need the fallback plan documented (smaller-model warm fallback + UI guidance).

sam_runtime: Noted. We'll include fallback route profiling and a quick decision matrix (when to fallback).

alex_marketing: Thanks all. If anything slips please ping #release-war-room or DM me. Will use the artifacts for the webinar slide and press blurb. :thumbsup:
